questions.prompt: In a typical synchronous design, when will the data launched by a flip-flop at a given clock edge be captured by the adjacent flip-flop in its fanout?
The arrival time of the data at the capture flip-flop does NOT depend on the following:
options: Setup time of the capture flip-flop
Clock-to-Q delay of the launch flip-flop
Delay on the clock path of the launch flip-flop
questions.accepted: Setup time of the capture flip-flop

questions.prompt: The hold requirement constraint does NOT depend on the following quantities in a typical synchronous circuit?
options: Delay on the clock path of the launch flip-flop
Delay on the clock path of the capture flip-flop

questions.prompt: The delay calculation for a given stage performed during Static Timing Analysis will NOT depend on the following:
options: Driver model of the driving cell
Receiver model of the driver cell

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT considered in creating scenarios for multi-mode multi-corner (MMMC) analysis?
We have defined a late derating factor of 1.1. For the early analysis, which of the following quantities should be multiplied by the above derating factor to make the analysis more pessimistic?
options: Clock-to-Q delay of the launch flip-flop
Delay of the clock launch path
Delay of the clock capture path
questions.accepted: Delay of the clock capture path

questions.prompt: Consider the AND gate shown below:

image.alt: A three-input AND gate with inputs A, B, C and output Z, followed by a table of arc delays and output slews (A to Z: 10 ps, 20 ps; B to Z: 20 ps, 5 ps; C to Z: 30 ps, 10 ps) and a table of pin arrival times (A: 5 ps, B: 6 ps, C: 12 ps).

options: Arrival Time = 42 ps Output Slew = 10 ps
Arrival Time = 15 ps Output Slew = 20 ps
Arrival Time = 42 ps Output Slew = 20 ps
Arrival Time = 15 ps Output Slew = 10 ps
questions.accepted: Arrival Time = 42 ps Output Slew = 20 ps

questions.prompt: For the same question above, what will be the arrival time and the output slew at the pin Z when Path Based Analysis (PBA) is performed for the setup check or late-mode check through the arc B → Z?
options: Arrival Time = 26 ps Output Slew = 20 ps
Arrival Time = 26 ps Output Slew = 5 ps
Arrival Time = 42 ps Output Slew = 10 ps
Arrival Time = 42 ps Output Slew = 5 ps
